CR2-01.description: Separate new temporary conversations from recoverable drafts; reject different transcripts sharing an idempotent save identity.

CR2-02.description: Finish empty terminal native responses, preserving reasoning, finish reason and usage.

CR2-03.description: Propagate retrieval errors and Retry-After through the full chat path; do not invoke the main model after failed retrieval.

CR2-04.description: Exclude Save As Copy projections from historical statistics.

CR2-05.description: Freeze trusted pre-ledger usage before continuing an old reply; count new calls separately.

CR2-06.description: Delete associated content for all authors by owned chat IDs; account deletion also removes that author’s content elsewhere.

CR2-07.description: Use one canonical projection for sealing and restoring temporary native messages, including provider extensions.

CR2-08.description: Map Gemini inline images into the existing media channel in streaming and nonstreaming responses; temporary images remain inline.

CR2-09.description: Compare effective inherited protocols when reusing migration targets.

CR2-10.description: Reject stale server discovery results under a revision check and database write lock.

CR2-11.description: Clear transient usage errors on successful 304 responses without replacing cached data.
